notes.title: Preparing the release version
notes.notes:
We are preparing the Release version. The message system has been disabled. Quest items have been renamed. We also deleted some messages while loading. We are also preparing a demo mode.

The game engine, unity, has been updated.

notes.title: Tentative Fix : Save the number of chests after a win
notes.notes: The number of chests obtained after winning was not correctly saved when the player exits the game immediately after winning.

notes.title: Video game arcades are now animated
notes.notes: We are thinking of adding more animation. Does that sound like a good idea?

notes.title: Small improvement on the drag function with the mouse
notes.notes:
When you move with the drag (hold down the left mouse button) or using the arrow keys on the keyboard, the information of the objects over which the cursor passes is no longer displayed as long as you are in drag mode.

There is less visual interference.

notes.title: Unity version update
notes.notes: The game is upgrading to the 2021 version of Unity. Normally nothing should change, except fix some bugs and maybe improve performance a bit.

notes.title: New option for advanced players
notes.notes:
Is the hard level too easy? Do you win every time? There is now the "Hint for Object behind" option in the option menu. 

When the option is deactivated, you will no longer have any clue that an object is hiding behind another.

notes.title: New Challenge Item: The Gem Meteorite
notes.notes: This new item can be purchased with gold as one of the daily challenge cards in the store. The gem meteorite can be earned for free by completing challenges in the upcoming challenge system.

notes.title: (Attempt) Fix the store not showing in the main menu and blocking the interface.
notes.notes:
Today's challenge daily card was incorrectly saved to the store causing the interface to freeze. We have made the changes so that there are no more mistakes in the future. 

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: New Challenge Item: The Overwhelmed Owner.
notes.notes: This new item can be purchased with gold as one of the daily challenge cards in the store. The overwhelmed owner can be earned for free by completing challenges in the upcoming challenge system.

notes.title: Increased the visibility of the signal that there are not many moves left.
notes.notes: + Added a new challenge card of the day: The Fairy Wand. It is a tool that allows you to remove up to 4 fairies at once.

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.notes:
- Removed the orange dot that appeared in the middle of the screen while pressing the "alt" keyboard key.

- Changed the name of the normal banana so that it is no longer called Rotten.

- Attempt to fix a rare bug where a player could have endless chests to open.

notes.title: Amazing Fix Fairies Preview
notes.notes:
A new card of the day has been added to the store. It will allow you to start collecting challenge items (fairies in this case) before the Challenge system is released.

Note : These items will not cost gold if you successfully complete the challenges when the upcoming system will be available.

notes.title: Characters now have powers!
notes.notes:
Upgrade your characters to level 3 so that they get a power that matches their style. Please note: several cards and a lot of gold are required.

We've also made some adjustments to the store and to the costs required to upgrade items to level 2.

Fix:

- The bonus item now displays the correct chest when there is a mouse over.

- (Attempt) Fixed the number of moves that did not reach zero at the end.

notes.title: New tools and characters.
notes.notes:
Five new tools: The drill, the wood chisels, the poison vial, the medical kit and the mobile terminal. We have listened to you and there are finally tools for removing furniture (the drill and the chisels). The Poison Vial is a dramatic way to remove characters.

Do you like the three musketeers? We have added Milady and Constance to accompany d'Artagnan.

And I almost forgot, there are new items. My favorite is the "House for sale - Renovated" sign.

notes.title: New monsters are in town
notes.notes:
7 new monsters have just been added to the inventory. Warning: some hang on the walls.

Bugs Fixed

- The Impressionist painting no longer moves when it is repaired.

- Improved click precision: Fixed an issue where it could happen that an object different from the one displayed on the mouse over is clicked.

notes.title: New animals

notes.title: Gold reward are now tied to the level score.
notes.notes: The higher score you get, the more gold you will earn. Use the bonus object more often to increase your final score and get more gold.

notes.notes: The bonus object as well as the object displayed as a hint when you hover your cursor over the category (on the left of the screen) have a sharper and more defined image.

21 new characters are added to the character category. Will you be able to save them all from the infamous Victorian mansion?

notes.title: Population explosion
notes.notes: 21 new characters are added to the character category. Will you be able to save them all from the infamous Victorian mansion?

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Bouldure and Monfrow monster names now display correctly in-game.

- The chick is no longer shifted when you click it.

- Improved saving of timers to prevent time being forgotten when entering and exiting the menu.

- Moved a hidden object impossible to find behind the top of the greenhouse.

- Fixed the bonus item interface that remained green after picking up the bonus item.

- Moved the big kite to prevent it protruding from the sky in the house.

notes.title: New hint system on categories.
notes.notes:
When you hover your cursor over one of the category icons on the left of the screen, one of the category's searched objects will be displayed next to it. Very useful when you have an item left to find or you don't know what kind of item belongs in a category.


[b]Bug Fixs.[/b]

- The balloons will no longer protrude from the floor.

- The game is automatically saved on exit. Should solve several problems with unsaved inventories.

- Added a check to adjust the move count if it is missing one to complete a game.

- The lose sequence is faster. The bug of the lose sequence that is activated when taking a tool to complete a category should no longer occur.

notes.title: Added a new monster and fixed some bugs.
notes.notes:
- Addition of a monster: the mimic chest.

- There is even more chance of getting a missing item when opening a chest.

- The spider web is more visible in the bathroom.

- Spiders are now targeted by the insecticide.

- Fixed a case where the red circles appeared when finishing a category using a tool.

- Fixed a few cases where the move count could be bad at the end.

- Made more robust the save after receiving the reward in the win menu.

notes.title: The house is dirtier than ever!
notes.notes:
Mold, wall stains and fungus are now all over the house.

There are also 3 new treasures and 9 new monsters in the inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309281/739247826efa704f3d37fb94cf790b3e6b06c62d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New objects
notes.notes:
- Added new treasures and monsters in the inventory.

- Several new flying objects.

- The house category has been revamped to make the house dirtier. Be careful, some building materials that were considered junk are now part of the house category.

notes.title: Mutliple bug fix
notes.notes:
- The hint now shows a visible object first when possible.

- The random generation of levels has been improved. Objects occupy more different spaces.

- Fixed a rare bug where it happened that an item that needs multiple levels of repair could not be clicked. It was then impossible to complete a level.

- There should be at least one new item, upgrade or gold for every opened chest until the inventory is full.

- The number of hints in normal mode is now 2 instead of 1.

- Chests and gold on the won game menu were canceled if the menu was closed too quickly. Fixed.

- Fixed an incorrect count on the number of items to find for a category when a multi-destroy item was removed.

- The text for the maximum level reached on a card has been clarified.

The majority of known bugs are fixed. We will now be able to spend more time adding new content or functionality. Thanks to everyone who reported bugs on the forums and Facebook.

notes.title: New Hint system
notes.notes:
There are now 1 to 3 hints available depending on the difficulty level. 

Do not wait until you have one move left before using it, the object you are looking for could be hidden under another object.

notes.title: Fix an impossible to find objet
notes.notes: Behind a plant in the greenhouse.

notes.title: Improved the object inspection interface.
notes.notes: The information for objects that have multiple level of repair is now displayed in the item inspection interface.

notes.title: Improvements to the cursor accuracy
notes.notes:
From now on the cursor will select the closest object around when it is not directly above an object. The goal is that small objects can be more easily selected from a far away distance. It should also be easier to select objects that are around a pile of objects.

If you only see a few pixels of an object, it will still be necessary in several cases that you remove the object above it in order to take the one under.

Let us know how it feel.

notes.title: New hint: Panel for showing that an object is hiding behind another object.
notes.notes:
A panel indicate whether one or more objects can hide behind another object. The goal is to decrease the luck factor for finding small items. On the other hand, the player will now have to use more strategy and observation to win.


COMING NEXT

We will try to improve the precision to detect and click on small objects with the mouse.

notes.title: Improvements to the lost game sequence
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENT TO THE LOST GAME SEQUENCE

When losing, the items from 1-2 categories closest to being completed are now circled at the end.

The objective is to show the player the solution of the house and that the objects were present.

It is now also possible to navigate and zoom in the house even if the lose panel is displayed.

The code that displays the remaining objects will be reused for a future hint system.


BUGS

- The lose panel disappeared and did not come back when the "space" and "enter" keys were pressed on the keyboard.  Fixed.

- The broken floors of the lobby and media room could be invisible. Fixed.

- We had the bug of the unclickable object once. The information allowed us to improve the quality of the code involved. We have not been able to reproduce it since.


COMING SOON

We are working on a hint system that will tell how many objects are totally or partially hidden behind an object. The goal is to increase strategy and observation and reduce the luck factor for finding small items.

notes.title: Hint to find the last object
notes.notes:
- We wanted to speed up the games when there are 1-2 items left to find to win. Depending on the difficulty level, a clue will appear after a certain time to help the player locate the last object.

- We found a bug in the item creation system. We are not not sure if it is related with the impossible to click objects - but it could.

COMING NEXT

The sequence when the game is over is being improved. We want to tell the player where were the items they were looking for before losing.

notes.title: Fixed the display order of all items in the mansion.
notes.notes:
The occurrence of the wrong item being clicked when two items stacked on top of each other should be reduced by 99%.

NEXT

We are looking to find a solution to detect the impossible to find objects when there are only 1 or 2 items left on the mansion.

notes.title: Fix : The move panel was not showing up after the first time.
notes.notes: The panel is now also displayed when there is only one movement left.

notes.title: Added a sound to the message indicating that there are few moves left.
notes.notes:
- Correction of the text for the "decorations" category in French.

- Modification in the code to prevent other cases of impossible to click objects.

- Added a sound to the message indicating that there are few moves left.

notes.title: We are polling player feedback for the new features.
notes.notes:
There are several possible features that we can add to the game and we need the input of the players to determine the priority of what we are going to do next.

A survey is underway on the Amazing Fix Facebook page. If you want us to improve the game, you are invited.

notes.title: Addition of the "Decoration" category in the inventory.
notes.notes:
+ The decoration category is now displayed correctly in the inventory.

+ Remaining categories count over an object inspection panel is updated faster.

+ The sign of $ has been reversed in interfaces.

+ Improved controls between mouse drag and keyboard move VS side scrolling.

+ Fixed the chests that moved to the right when clicked.

+ Limit the purchase number of the card of the day.

+ Fixed some bugs with the inspection panel over the card of the day.

+ Tentative fix for removing the correct amount of gold after a card upgrade.

notes.title: Attempt to fix impossible to click objects
notes.notes: We were not able to reproduce this problem but we fixed two bugs that could be related in the tools.

notes.title: Improve the card of the day and minor fixes
notes.notes:
- The card of the day can now be purchased individually. Prices have been reduced accordingly.

- Further improvements to the positioning of the inspection panel when moving the mouse over an item.

- Reduces the possibility of obtaining two of the same items when opening a chest.

- The carnivorous plant was not well referenced in the inventory.

- Fixed several issues with objects one on top of each other.  Sometimes it was impossible to remove the object on top without clicking the object underneath. There are probably a few more like that to fix in the game.

KNOWN ISSUES

- It's impossible to click on some objects after using a tool.

notes.title: Fixed some cases where there are missing moves at the end.
notes.notes:
- Best random generation of categories in the difficult level.

- Adjustment of the bonus and starting moves in the difficult level in order to limit the cases where there is too few moves.

- Fixed the case of a tool that would forget to destroy an object in target.

notes.title: Fixed an impossible to find item, more rewards when winning and more
notes.notes:
- An object could be randomly placed under the floor above the "Mactari" poster. It was impossible to find without hovering the mouse cursor over it.

- There are more chests and gold when you win.

- The chances of finding a gem or a tool in a chest have been increased.

- The chest and free gold in the main menu now appear every 8 hours.

- The inspection panel that appears when we place our cursor over an object has less tendency to hide it.

- Fixed several text errors.

notes.title: Display of a message at the start of a level.
notes.notes: In order to inform the players how many moves they receive by category completed.

notes.title: Added text to indicate the move bonus per completed categories.
notes.notes: We also corrected some spelling mistakes.

notes.title: Amazing Fix is now available
notes.notes:
The game is now available for download in Early Access, a little earlier than the initial date. 

Thank you for joining us. :)

notes.title: Improving Amazing Fix for casual gamers.
notes.notes:
We did playtests with a very casual player. Several small modifications had to be made to Amazing Fix. The most important being that the categories that are pointed to by the mouse cursor are now highlighted on the left interface bar. The intention is to make it clear to the player which of the categories will be affected by a click. Game is still in development.
